body:
This was an attempt to fix the [vector-DSS failure on L40S nodes](https://buildkite.com/clima/climacore-ci/builds/7732#01a0892c-2f26-4444-ab08-d30ddc1da4d7). It turned out that the root cause of the failure is an L40S hardware configuration problem. but the changes in this PR are nonetheless useful cleanup. 

Adds a ground-truth distributed DSS test, `NTuple{K, Float64}` constant fields for `K ∈ (1, 3, 8)` in `ddss_ne32_cs.jl`, that separates a message-size failure from an `Nf > 1` code-path failure.

It shows that the `ne = 32` vector-DSS failure on L40S nodes is in the cluster's MPI stack. On the L40S nodes, 
when two ranks on the same node exchange device buffers larger than UCX's rendezvous threshold (roughly 8 KB), the transfer over the `cuda_ipc `transport completes without any error but the receive buffer is left unwritten (the receiver gets zeros). Smaller messages, which go through the eager path, arrive correctly: `K = 1` (4.6 KB) passes, `K = 3` and `8` fail, and either `UCX_TLS=^cuda_ipc` or `UCX_RNDV_THRESH=inf` makes everything pass (tested in [climacore-ci build 7834](https://buildkite.com/clima/climacore-ci/builds/7834)).  The same job is correct on the P100 nodes. 

The fix is a UCX setting in the cluster environment.

Also raises the ClimaComms compat floor to 0.6.12, which synchronizes the CUDA device across streams around MPI operations, and tidies `compute_ghost_send_recv_idx` (non-persistent requests for its one-shot exchange, the mesh's `reversed` flag instead of a hard-coded `true`, two unused copies removed). No results change.
title: Add a ground-truth distributed DSS test and require ClimaComms 0.6.12

body:
Adds ClimaLand end-to-end benchmarks to the downstream perf pipeline so that we can easily catch performance regressions in the future.

Changes
- Added two GPU steps to the downstream perf pipeline that use a new script ` run-land-benchmark.sh` to run ClimaLand's own `experiments/benchmarks/{soil,snowy_land}.jl` against the local ClimaCore.
- Renamed `check-sypd.sh` to `check-perf.sh` and updated it to determine the perf baseline from the last passing `main` build, as we do in ClimaAtmos

Blocked on merging https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaLand.jl/pull/1889
title: Add land model end to end benchmark
